# Configuration
# Priority: CLI > this file > built-in defaults
# Uncomment values to set defaults
# View settings: notepipe config show

[defaults]
# Optional yt-dlp cookie sources; both may be set
#cookies = "/path/to/cookies.txt"
#cookies_from_browser = "firefox:default-release"
# Output root, organized by platform/title/ID
#out = "{OUT}"
# Similarity (0,1]; higher captures more slides
#similarity = {SIMILARITY}
# Frame sampling interval (seconds)
#sample_interval = {SAMPLE_INTERVAL}
# Minimum interval between slides (seconds)
#cooldown = {COOLDOWN}
# Maximum downloaded video height
#max_height = {MAX_HEIGHT}
# first: immediate; stable: wait for animations
#slide_mode = "{SLIDE_MODE}"
#stable_secs = {STABLE_SECS}
# Compare only this region
#roi = "40%,0%-100%,100%"
# auto: subtitles first, then speech recognition
# subtitle: subtitles only; asr: speech recognition only
#transcript_source = "{TRANSCRIPT_SOURCE}"
# Output formats: md, html, json
#formats = [{FORMATS}]
# Keep downloaded video after success
#keep_video = {KEEP_VIDEO}
# Continue interrupted transcription
#resume = {RESUME}

[asr]
# HTTP dialect: transcriptions, chat
#mode = "transcriptions"
# Service root or full endpoint; ignored when command is set
#base_url = ""
# Optional; CLI also reads NOTEPIPE_ASR_API_KEY
#api_key = ""
#model = ""
# Empty language means automatic detection
#language = ""
# Parallel requests, clamped to 1..=16
#concurrency = {ASR_CONCURRENCY}
# Managed adapter argv; notepipe adds --host and --port
#command = []
#max_speech = {MAX_SPEECH}
#vad_threshold = {VAD_THRESHOLD}
#min_silence = {MIN_SILENCE}

[llm]
# Optional AI proofreading
enabled = {LLM_ENABLED}
#base_url = "{LLM_BASE_URL}"
# Optional; CLI also reads NOTEPIPE_LLM_API_KEY
#api_key = ""
#model = "{LLM_MODEL}"
# Custom proofreading instructions
#prompt = ""
# Attach slides; requires an image-capable model
#vision = {LLM_VISION}
# Concurrent requests
#concurrency = {LLM_CONCURRENCY}
# Add AI summaries; requires enabled = true
#summarize = {LLM_SUMMARIZE}
# Bilingual notes: target language; skipped when the text is already in it
#translate = "en"

en:
Quick start:
  notepipe ./lecture.mp4
  notepipe https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VIDEO_ID
  notepipe ./lecture.mp4 -o ./notes

Transcripts:
  Platform subtitles are used first; speech recognition runs when none exist.
  --transcript-source subtitle  Use subtitles only
  --transcript-source asr       Force speech recognition

Next steps:
  notepipe doctor              Check dependencies and settings
  notepipe config init         Create a configuration template
  notepipe llm setup           Set up optional AI proofreading
  notepipe summarize ./notes   Summarize existing notes

The first conversion in a terminal offers setup; scripts should pass options explicitly.
Use <command> --help for details.
zh-Hans:
快速开始：
  notepipe ./lecture.mp4
  notepipe https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VIDEO_ID
  notepipe ./lecture.mp4 -o ./notes

转写方式：
  默认优先使用平台字幕，无字幕时使用语音识别。
  --transcript-source subtitle  仅使用字幕
  --transcript-source asr       强制语音识别

下一步：
  notepipe doctor              检查依赖与配置
  notepipe config init         生成配置模板
  notepipe llm setup           配置可选的 AI 校对
  notepipe summarize ./notes   为已有笔记生成摘要

交互终端首次转换会引导配置；脚本请显式传入所需参数。
使用 <command> --help 查看子命令帮助。
zh-Hant:
快速開始：
  notepipe ./lecture.mp4
  notepipe https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VIDEO_ID
  notepipe ./lecture.mp4 -o ./notes

轉寫方式：
  預設優先使用平台字幕，無字幕時使用語音辨識。
  --transcript-source subtitle  僅使用字幕
  --transcript-source asr       強制語音辨識

下一步：
  notepipe doctor              檢查依賴與設定
  notepipe config init         產生設定範本
  notepipe llm setup           設定可選的 AI 校對
  notepipe summarize ./notes   為已有筆記產生摘要

互動式終端首次轉換會引導設定；指令碼請明確傳入所需參數。
使用 <command> --help 查看子命令說明。
ja:
クイックスタート：
  notepipe ./lecture.mp4
  notepipe https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VIDEO_ID
  notepipe ./lecture.mp4 -o ./notes

文字起こし：
  プラットフォームの字幕を優先し、ない場合は音声認識を使います。
  --transcript-source subtitle  字幕のみ
  --transcript-source asr       音声認識を強制

次のステップ：
  notepipe doctor              依存関係と設定を確認
  notepipe config init         設定テンプレートを作成
  notepipe llm setup           任意の AI 校正を設定
  notepipe summarize ./notes   既存のノートに要約を追加

ターミナルでの初回変換では設定を案内します。スクリプトでは必要な引数を明示してください。
詳細は <command> --help を参照してください。
